brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.requirement: Wall-hung spice rack with at least three bins
requirements.evidence: 3x hex-bin-half bins at -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 (bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-half) in a horizontal 3-cell row
2x hex-acc-keyhole on piece -1,0,0 (accessory:0#-1,0#1 and #2) – slots 1 and 2 provide wall mounting points

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal rack with three half-depth bins for spice jars/pots, hung via two keyhole hangers on the left cell. Caps and joint bolts applied; dressed with small pots to show spice-jar use.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
